tools.name: generate_spending_report
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches a bank or credit card statement (text PDF, CSV or Excel export) and asks to turn it into a budget, see where their money goes, find subscriptions or recurring charges, or total spending by category or month. Returns spending by category, income vs spending and net, mo

tools.name: categorize_spending
tools.description: Use this when the user pastes or lists bank or credit card transactions (date, description, amount) and asks where their money goes, to categorize spending, make a budget from them, or find subscriptions and recurring charges. Accepts a list of rows or pasted text/CSV. Returns the same report as gen
